_what: A per-route re-test of BLK-NO-EMC-DATA against the committed EMC-tissue expression reads, for the sixteen routes whose required_validation is marked feasible_today=false on that blocker AND whose own text names an expression or tissue read. One verdict per required_validation ENTRY, never one verdict for the set.
_why: AUT-PD-116 records that sixteen live routes sit behind this blocker and that a committed artifact answers it for six of them. Sixteen routes behind one string is the defect; replacing it with a different single string would repeat it. CLAUDE.md §0: 'Blocked is a claim that needs evidence, and it is usually wrong' — and the same section's converse, which governs every row below: declaring a route unblocked when the data does not support its next step puts in-silico work on a foundation that is not there.
_execution_model: $0. No fetch, no CI, no GPU. Every reading below was already committed; this file adjudicates, it does not measure.
_this_artifact_computes_nothing_new: Every figure has its one home in research/modalities/emc-expression-panels.json (readings) and research/modalities/emc-surface-normal-window.json (the normal-tissue prior). This file carries ADDRESSES into them and never re-types a number. The precedent is research/modalities/census-route-expression-grading.json, which states the same rule for the same source.
_language_discipline: ⛔ NOTHING HERE ASSERTS EFFICACY, SELECTIVITY, SAFETY, A THERAPEUTIC WINDOW OR CLINICAL READINESS for any agent, antigen or class in EMC. A transcript is not a protein, a copy number, an activity, a dependency, a glycan epitope or a presented peptide. An UNBLOCKED verdict below is a statement about a RECORD, never about a therapy.

the_blocker_as_written.⭐_the_finding_in_one_sentence: THE BLOCKER NEVER CLAIMED EXPRESSION DATA WAS MISSING. Its own record scopes it to FUNCTIONAL-GENOMICS data and twice refuses a retirement offered to it — for the fourth SRA cohort and for the 2026-08-24 methylation cohort — on exactly the ground that a tumour profiling dataset is not a dependency screen. Sixteen routes attached an EXPRESSION-or-TISSUE-read requirement to it anyway. The blocker is right and the routes are wrong to cite it.
the_blocker_as_written.⛔_therefore: Nothing in this file retires BLK-NO-EMC-DATA or weakens it. No EMC dependency screen, CRISPR screen or ex-vivo drug-response panel has appeared. It continues to name exactly what it always named.

the_precedent_this_correction_follows.what_it_records_verbatim: Six routes across ST-LOCOREGIONAL and ST-STRATEGY inherited BLK-NO-EMC-DATA, whose own record scopes it to FUNCTIONAL-GENOMICS data (one DepMap line, no CRISPR). None of the six needs a dependency screen, so all six lost it. Only FOUR gained this one.
the_precedent_this_correction_follows.⭐_why_it_is_the_model: The same defect, already adjudicated once, and the correction was deliberately NON-UNIFORM: four routes gained a new blocker, two were unblocked outright, and one was left showing a disagreement for its grade owner to settle rather than papered over. the_artifact_that_answers_the_expression.what_it_is: Targeted gene and curated-panel reads in the two readable EMC array series — GSE24369 on GPL6244 (6 EMC vs 29 comparator sarcomas) and GSE4303 on GPL3290 (10 vs 6). 479 gene_reads; twenty reads plus a control.
the_artifact_that_answers_the_expression.the_control_passes_so_the_reads_are_lice: reads.control — ENO3 is clearly higher in EMC on BOTH platforms, which is the artifact's own stated precondition for quoting anything below it (reads.control.how_to_read_this_first). NR4A3 is higher on GPL6244.
⛔_what_it_cannot_settle_and_every_verdic: NOT SURFACE LOCALISATION OR DENSITY. Same field, (2).

NOT TUMOUR-RESTRICTED. Every contrast is EMC vs OTHER SARCOMAS, not tumour vs normal. Same field, (3). The normal-tissue axis lives in emc-surface-normal-window.json and is an RNA prior, never a safety statement.
NOT DECONVOLVED. Bulk archival tissue; a stromal antigen can read high because the compartment is present. Same field, (4).
NOT A DEPENDENCY. reads.read_13_TXN_CDK.what_it_cannot_settle — 'a flat read does NOT exclude the class'.
NOT A GLYCAN EPITOPE. reads.read_2_CS_GAG_PAPS.what_it_cannot_settle — 'A SULFATION PATTERN HAS NO GENE'.
NOT PRESENTATION. No peptide-HLA quantity exists anywhere in the artifact.
READABILITY IS AN INSTRUMENT STATE, NEVER A LOW READING. A gene with no probe is `readable: false` and nothing in this file may report it as absent.

verdict_scale.UNBLOCKED: the required_validation entry, AS WRITTEN, is satisfied by a committed artifact. BLK-NO-EMC-DATA comes off that entry and the entry is marked done with its citation.
verdict_scale.PARTIAL: one disjunct or one axis of the entry is satisfied and the rest is not. The entry must be SPLIT so the taken half is recorded and the untaken half keeps a blocker that names it correctly.
verdict_scale.STILL_BLOCKED_WRONG_BLOCKER: the entry is not satisfied, and BLK-NO-EMC-DATA is not what it is waiting on. The residual blocker is named.
verdict_scale.STILL_BLOCKED_BLOCKER_CORRECT: the entry is not satisfied and BLK-NO-EMC-DATA is the right blocker. ⚠ NO ROUTE IN THIS POPULATION SCORES THIS — by construction, because the population was selected for naming an expression or tissue read and this blocker is about functional-genomics data. RT-SYNLETH-DEP, which asks for 'an EMC-specific dependency screen', is the route that DOES correctly carry it, and it is outside this sixteen.

RT-CART-SURFACE.text_verbatim: A selective surface antigen confirmed on EMC tissue
RT-CART-SURFACE.⭐_what_actually_happened: This route's `next` says 'the antigen search re-runs automatically when EMC expression data lands'. IT LANDED, AND THE SEARCH RAN. read_8's cross_platform_board scores 100 genes; exactly five are CONCORDANT_UP_ON_BOTH (ALCAM, BGN, CD44, GPC1, VCAN), and of those only ALCAM carries a RESTRICTED normal-tissue window prior. A binder ladder for it is already recorded in research/modalities/alcam-precedent.json.
RT-CART-SURFACE.⛔⛔_AND_THIS_IS_THE_ROUTE_WHERE_THE_DANGE: DO NOT record a selective antigen. 'Selective' is not established and the route's own owning manuscript demotes the candidate: emc-surface-target-landscape.md reports ALCAM's EMC median in the sequencing cohort at 0.578 against a normal-organ median of 0.631 — below normal organs — and states that no candidate route names it. Unblocking a CAR-T route on a transcript contrast in n=6 and n=10 archival tumours, against an antigen its own exposure axis demotes, is precisely the error AUT-PD-116 records for RT-PRAME-IMMTAC, in the same direction.
RT-CART-SURFACE.the_claim_it_supports: The EMC-tissue antigen search the route was waiting on has been run over a 100-gene board and returned no antigen that is both concordantly elevated in EMC tissue and restricted on the normal-tissue prior once the exposure axis is applied.
RT-CART-SURFACE.next_action_the_data_now_permits: Replace next.best_next_action — 'the antigen search re-runs automatically when EMC expression data lands' is now a description of something that has happened, and leaving it standing hides a completed search behind a promise. Record the board, the five concordant genes and ALCAM's demotion. Drop BLK-NO-EMC-DATA from the entry.
RT-CART-SURFACE.readiness_missing: ['a selective surface antigen'] STAYS TRUE and is not edited.
RT-CART-SURFACE.residual_blocker: BLK-NO-WET-LAB (protein and surface density) and BLK-ANTIGEN-COLD, both already on the entry.

RT-TRABECTEDIN.text_verbatim: A larger EMC series, or a measured effect on the fusion's transcriptional output
